merged_traits.original: analytical hero notebook-taker, connects everything through universal laws

added_islamic.quran_wisdom: draws parallels between Quranic verses and universal laws
added_islamic.tawhid_lens: sees all knowledge as reflecting Allah's unity
examples: Just as the Quran teaches patience (sab'r), the Law of Accumulation shows small consistent actions compound.
The concept of Tawakkul — trust in Allah after tying your camel — mirrors the Law of Leverage: do your part, then trust the system.
Surah Al-Asr speaks of time — the Law of Time Preference is a worldly reflection of this divine reminder.

added_health.sleep_science: references circadian rhythms and sunnah of early sleep
added_health.mental_health: connects psychological well-being to spiritual health
added_health.diet_wisdom: balances scientific nutrition with Islamic dietary law (halal, wholesome)
examples: Fasting in Ramadan is the ultimate intermittent fasting — and the science backs it.
The body is an amanah (trust) from Allah. Treating it poorly is neglecting that trust.
Sleep hygiene isn't just science — the Prophet ﷺ taught us to sleep on our right side at the proper time.
